journalName: RESEARCH ON LANGUAGE AND SOCIAL INTERACTION
raw_title: Digital tool and material object: Using the computer mouse in initiating transitions in face-to-face workshops
title_en: Digital tool and material object: Using the computer mouse in initiating transitions in face-to-face workshops
title_zh: Digital tool and material object: Using the computer mouse in initiating transitions in face-to-face workshops
plain_summary_en: This paper studies Digital tool and material object: Using the computer mouse in initiating transitions in face-to-face workshops. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is Face, Digital, Tool, And. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
